artifact_policy.committed_artifacts: compact CSV/JSON/PNG summaries and this manifest
artifact_policy.per_run_artifacts: generated only under a temporary output directory; not committed

pilot.selection_rule: pilot cases are executed before convergence; roles are recorded without relabeling the measured classification

classification.numerically_unresolved: at least one unresolved/failing seeded trial or missing denominator
classification.trial_mixed: at least one straight and one buckled-single, with no unresolved trial

size_comparison.description: same target G_b and chi at a second initial length; non-contact deterministic fixture plus seeded initial imperfection trials
